name: Review Stripe refund requests with an AI agent and refund on approval
description: A refund request is posted to a webhook with a payment intent ID, amount and reason. An AI agent looks up the payment and its earlier refunds with the Stripe tools, checks them against a simple refund policy and recommends an amount. A person reviews the recommendation in an approval form and can change the amount. Only an approved refund is created in Stripe.
shortDescription: An AI agent checks refund requests against Stripe, and a person approves before any money moves.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with two Stripe tools, Get Payment Intent and List Refunds
Refund policy in the system prompt, easy to replace with your own
Approval step after the agent, delivered to the Approval Tasks inbox, with the refund amount editable in the form
Refund created with the Stripe Create Refund action only after approval
prerequisites: Stripe connection (start with a test mode secret key)
A system that posts refund requests to the workflow's webhook URL as JSON with paymentIntentId, customerEmail, amount and reason
Someone who answers requests in the Approval Tasks inbox, or swap the Approval Task channel for Slack, email or another channel
Server public URL configured, so the webhook and the approval form link can be reached
idealFor: E-commerce and finance teams that want refund requests pre-checked by AI while a person signs off on every refund.
steps: Trigger: a refund request is posted to the webhook.
Review the request: the AI Agent calls the Stripe Get Payment Intent and List Refunds tools and returns a recommendation, an amount and an explanation.
Approve refund: the run pauses and sends an approval request to the Approval Tasks inbox, with a form that shows the recommendation and lets the reviewer change the amount.
Approved: create the refund in Stripe for the approved amount and log it.
Rejected: log the rejection and the reviewer's note, and refund nothing.
